# The Southward Cut

The company takes inventory while walking: one immediate chase escaped, one narrow piece of evidence preserved, and no honest claim that the abandoned road reaches Harrowcross.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Character recollections are stored separately and may disagree.
